name: PressRoom
$comment: The one accent is --your-move (blue) and means only: this waits for you. covers: every case carries a small coloured cover, the colour from one meta key (the cockpit coloured by track; this demo's pieces carry no track, so by label), the fallback for everything else.

create.$comment: A new piece starts as an idea, like a claim starts as a report (Chris, 2026-10-29). Format and series come from the value lists; the number follows the PressRoom rule: in a series it counts there (SIM-03), else the placeholder xxx until it is numbered.
